Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior or Lead Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and continuous improvement of our professional trading tools and end-to-end trading experience.

This role is focused on products for active and professional traders. The scope includes advanced market analysis, trading workflows, order execution, position and risk management, workspace customisation, and selected automation capabilities.

You will develop a deep understanding of how professional traders use leading platforms such as TradingView, 3Commas, Bookmap, ATAS, and Quantower, and translate those insights into a differentiated, reliable, and intuitive trading experience.

Experience in the crypto industry is a strong plus. We welcome candidates who have built professional trading products for equities, futures, options, FX, commodities, or other electronic markets. Experience with crypto markets and products is a strong advantage.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and delivery of professional trading tools and the broader trading experience.

•

Build a deep understanding of active and professional traders, including their daily workflows, trading behaviours, pain points, and expectations.

•

Lead the development and improvement of market analysis, charting, order execution, position management, account monitoring, and workspace customisation.

•

Identify opportunities to introduce advanced trading and automation capabilities that improve efficiency while keeping users in control of their trading decisions.

•

Improve the quality of the end-to-end trading journey, from discovering an opportunity and placing an order through execution, position monitoring, and post-trade review.

•

Ensure the product meets professional standards for performance, stability, accuracy, usability, and transparency, particularly during periods of high market volatility.

•

Conduct structured user research and competitor analysis across professional trading terminals, charting platforms, and trading automation products.

•

Define product success metrics and use customer feedback, behavioural data, and trading data to evaluate performance and guide priorities.

•

Work closely with engineering, design, data, quantitative research, risk, compliance, operations, customer support, and commercial teams.

•

Translate complex trader needs and market concepts into clear product requirements and intuitive user experiences.

•

Manage technical and commercial trade-offs, dependencies, and delivery risks across multiple teams and product areas.

•

Communicate product strategy, priorities, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders and distributed teams.

•

Support and mentor other product managers and contribute to the broader trading product strategy

What We Look For In You

•

5-7+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record of delivering complex user-facing products.

•

Meaningful experience building professional trading tools, trading terminals, charting or market-data products, execution products, or trading automation solutions.

•

Relevant experience may come from equities, futures, options, FX, commodities, multi-asset platforms, or crypto. Direct experience at a crypto company is not required.

•

Strong understanding of electronic trading workflows, including market data, order placement and execution, position management, margin, P&L, and risk controls.

•

Familiarity with leading professional trading products such as TradingView, 3Commas, Bookmap, ATAS, Quantower, or comparable platforms.

•

A strong understanding of the needs of active traders and the ability to simplify sophisticated trading workflows without removing essential control or flexibility.

•

Experience owning the full product lifecycle, including research, strategy, prioritisation, requirements, delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.

•

Strong product judgement and the ability to balance customer value, usability, technical complexity, business impact, operational risk, and regulatory requirements.

•

Demonstrated ability to use qualitative research and quantitative data to make product decisions.

•

Experience working closely with engineering and design teams on real-time, data-intensive, or high-performance products.

•

Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence teams and senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

•

Ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and deliver results in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment.

•

Excellent written and spoken English. English is the working language for meetings, documentation, and daily collaboration.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience with crypto spot, perpetual futures, options, CEX, DEX, or on-chain trading products.

•

Hands-on familiarity with professional trading platforms or experience as an active trader.

•

Experience with advanced trading features, algorithmic execution, trading automation, or exchange connectivity.

•

Experience building products across web, desktop, and mobile trading environments.

•

Knowledge of exchange APIs, real-time market-data infrastructure, or broker and exchange integrations.

•

A technical, quantitative, engineering, economics, finance, or mathematics background.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

About the Onchain Data Team

The Onchain Data team builds the core data and technology infrastructure behind OKX Web3. We connect to diverse blockchain networks and collect, process, govern, interpret, and serve large-scale onchain data, delivering accurate, real-time, and reliable capabilities to Wallet, DEX, Explorer, Risk, CeFi, and AI products.

Our scope includes, but is not limited to:

•

Multi-chain data ingestion, parsing, computation, and unified data models;

•

Data capabilities for onchain assets, transactions, addresses, tokens, contracts, and projects;

•

Blockchain explorers, the Project Marketplace, Onchain Data APIs, bots, and agents;

•

Labels, risk detection, risk-control data, and security investigation capabilities;

•

DEX trending rankings, token scoring, and other onchain data products;

•

Global multi-region deployment, high-availability architecture, performance optimization, and system reliability;

•

Deep application of AI in engineering, data analysis, risk investigation, and intelligent operations.

You will work on challenges involving heterogeneous chains, large-scale data, real-time computation, high concurrency, high availability, data accuracy, and complex cross-functional collaboration. Your work can directly improve user experience, asset security, and business growth.

What You May Work On

This is a broad hiring track rather than a single fixed role. Your responsibilities will be matched to your strengths, experience, and interests, and may include one or more of the following:

•

Design, build, and evolve onchain data infrastructure, data services, or business systems, taking ownership of the quality and outcomes of critical modules.

•

Build multi-chain ingestion, real-time and batch computation, data governance, search, storage, and serving capabilities, continuously improving data accuracy, completeness, and freshness.

•

Contribute to blockchain explorers, the Project Marketplace, onchain assets, labels, risk control, DEX rankings, token scoring, and related platforms or products.

•

Identify critical technical and business problems, make sound judgments, design solutions, coordinate resources, drive execution, and review outcomes.

•

Build highly available, high-performance, scalable global systems, while continuously improving reliability, cost efficiency, delivery efficiency, and user experience.

•

Use AI tools deeply and explore agents, intelligent investigation, engineering automation, and intelligent operations, turning successful practices into reusable team capabilities.

•

Collaborate with product, data, security, algorithm, operations, and engineering teams to drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.

What We Value Most

Hunger — Curiosity and Drive

•

You stay curious about AI, Web3, emerging technologies, and new business domains, and can learn unfamiliar areas quickly.

•

You do not wait for instructions when facing a problem; you proactively understand the context, identify solutions, and drive execution.

•

You go beyond completing assigned tasks and continue to ask about outcomes, user value, and opportunities for improvement.

Cognition — Cognitive Ability and Judgment

•

You can quickly understand complex technical and business problems, build a structured mental model, and identify the core issue and key trade-offs.

•

When information is incomplete or the situation is uncertain, you can form sound judgments based on facts and logical reasoning.

•

You can compare the value, cost, risk, and long-term impact of different options, clearly explain your rationale, and turn decisions into executable plans and results.

What We Are Looking For

•

Strong computer science fundamentals and coding ability in at least one mainstream programming language, such as Java, Go, Python, or C++.

•

Clear logical thinking and strong problem decomposition skills, with the ability to independently solve complex technical or business problems.

•

Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:

•

Backend and distributed systems;

•

Real-time or batch data processing, data platforms, search, and storage;

•

High-concurrency, high-availability systems, and reliability engineering;

•

Risk control, security, strategy, or data analysis;

•

AI agents, LLM applications, or engineering productivity.

•

A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to drive initiatives through to measurable outcomes.

•

Open, direct, and effective communication, with a willingness to solve problems across teams.

•

Strong learning ability and growth potential. We value solid engineering fundamentals, but do not use mastery of one specific framework or middleware stack as the sole hiring criterion.

Preferred Qualifications

•

Experience with Web3, public blockchains, onchain data, wallets, DEXs, blockchain explorers, or smart contracts.

•

Familiarity with one or more blockchain technology models, such as EVM, UTXO, or Move.

•

Experience with large-scale data processing, stream processing, databases, messaging systems, caching, or search systems.

•

Experience in fintech, risk control, security, e-commerce, advertising, recommendation systems, or other complex internet businesses.

•

Proven examples of using AI tools to solve real problems and turning solutions into engineered or scalable capabilities.

•

Ability to work in English, or experience building global and multi-region systems.

•

Demonstrated technical judgment, business impact, or zero-to-one ownership in previous projects.

The Kind of Candidate We Hope to Meet

•

You can clearly explain the most complex problem you have solved, how you formed your judgment, and how you drove the solution to completion.

•

You have one or more clear strengths. We do not expect experience in every area, but we value meaningful depth or exceptional potential in at least one direction.

•

You are willing to understand users and business context instead of passively receiving requirements.

•

You are open to unfamiliar domains and can use AI and team collaboration to close knowledge gaps quickly.

•

You remain constructive in changing or uncertain environments and can keep moving work forward.

Why Join Us

•

Build core onchain data infrastructure for OKX Web3, directly supporting global users and multiple strategic businesses.

•

Work deeply with diverse blockchain technologies, onchain data systems, and real-world Web3 use cases.

•

Solve challenging engineering problems involving large-scale data, real-time computation, high availability, and global deployment.

•

Explore the intersection of AI and Onchain Data, applying frontier technologies to data, risk control, products, and engineering workflows.

•

Own meaningful problem spaces with the autonomy to identify issues, make judgments, and drive outcomes end to end.

•

Access career opportunities across Mainland China, Hong Kong SAR, and Singapore.

Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer on Topstep's TRM Engineering team, you'll build the products funded traders and our internal teams use every day: the trader-facing web experience, account and onboarding flows, payments and payouts, and the internal tooling the business runs on. We help new and experienced traders through training, insights into their trading patterns, and a smooth path to their payouts, and the systems behind that experience need to be reliable, secure, and easy to change as we grow.

You'll work primarily in TypeScript across Node.js and React, building cloud-native applications on AWS. Beyond shipping features, you'll own work end to end from design through production, raise the bar on code quality and engineering patterns across the team, and help make sure our systems scale safely as usage and complexity increase.

This role is ideal for an engineer who wants real ownership of systems that directly shape the trader experience, and who cares as much about how software runs in production as how it's written.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and operate full stack features end to end, from technical design through deployment and production support, with an emphasis on reliability, safe deployments, and operational simplicity.

• Partner with Product and Design during discovery to shape scope, surface technical trade-offs early, and provide credible estimates.

• Write technical designs for significant work and guide architecture decisions within your area, in partnership with your Engineering Manager and fellow senior engineers.

• Build automated testing, observability, and operational ownership into every stage of delivery.

• Raise the team's engineering bar through thoughtful code review, mentoring, and contributing to shared standards and patterns.

• Proactively identify and resolve issues across the stack, keeping our systems stable, performant, and ready to grow.

• Participate in the on-call rotation and incident follow-through, turning production issues into lasting fixes.

• Use AI-assisted development tools effectively and responsibly, within Topstep's standards for AI-built software.

Required Qualifications and Key Competencies

• 5+ years of experience building and operating production-grade systems with user-facing APIs, with demonstrated impact on scalability and reliability.

• Strong full stack foundation: backend development in TypeScript and Node.js with solid API design (REST, GraphQL), and modern frontend development in React and Next.js.

• Experience designing and operating distributed systems, including event-driven architectures, message queues, eventual consistency, and concurrency and race-condition handling, with a strong focus on performance, security, and maintainability.

• Strong database fundamentals with PostgreSQL or SQL Server, including schema design, migrations, indexing, and query optimization.

• A production mindset and bias toward action, embracing metrics, logging, tracing, on-call participation, and end-to-end ownership of delivery.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to a range of audiences and work well with Product, Design, and QA.

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in financial technology or highly regulated spaces where precision, traceability, and regulatory standards drive engineering decisions.

• Practical expertise with payment gateways, billing infrastructures, or authentication and user identity services.

• Hands-on familiarity with AWS services, container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern deployment pipelines using Argo CD or GitHub Actions.

• Proven capability leveraging AI developer tooling effectively while upholding rigorous standards for code health and maintainability.

• Track record of delivering high-scale, end-user applications with a sharp focus on intuitive product design.

Company Culture & Perks

• Topstep is an engaging working environment which ranges from fully remote to hybrid. We foster a culture of collaboration with cameras on during meetings and a robust Slack environment for communication.

• Seven Company-paid Holidays and generous Family Leave. Paid time off is front-loaded.

• Competitive 401(k) matching, health, dental, and vision insurance is offered for full time employees.

• Vacations are encouraged with a bonus for taking 5 consecutive days. Employee referrals are bonused. Topstep offers a food and groceries budget and contributes towards health and wellness.

New Hire Base Salary Range

• $155,000 - $200,000k annually.

• Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents.

• The compensation offered will take into account internal compensation structure and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Topstep is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees and applicants are valued. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

As a Senior Investigator in Coinbase’s Financial Intelligence Unit within Compliance (2LoD), you’ll help drive Coinbase’s financial crime investigations capability across multiple jurisdictions. This team leads complex reactive and proactive investigations, develops intelligence on emerging typologies and risk patterns, and translates investigative insights into high-quality SAR/STR decisions, escalations and programme improvements. You’ll work on high-impact matters across Coinbase’s global platform, partnering closely with MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and cross functional stakeholders to protect Coinbase and its customers from financial crime.

What you’ll do:

• Own end-to-end investigations into complex AML/CFT matters, from alert review or referral, through case development, disposition and SAR/STR submission to relevant FIUs.

• Conduct delegated MLRO reviews of Suspicious Transaction Reports and Suspicious Activity Reports prior to filing, ensuring accuracy, quality and regulatory defensibility.

• Lead proactive investigations, using transaction data, on-chain activity, trading behaviour and cross functional intelligence and OSINT to identify emerging typologies, threat patterns and high-risk activity.

• Develop actionable intelligence from casework and analytics to inform escalations, regulatory reporting, control enhancements and improvements to detection and investigation workflows.

• Partner internally with Country MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and other stakeholders on high-risk matters, information sharing and investigation strategy.

• Partner with law enforcement agencies and external stakeholders on suspicious activity reporting, information requests, and intelligence sharing.

• Support investigation quality through case review, structured feedback and contributions to policies, procedures, training and programme maturity.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 4+ years conducting and reviewing complex crypto financial crime investigations including experience across a range of products such as retail and institutional transfers, spot trading and derivatives.

• Experience preparing, reviewing and filing SARs/STRs with strong understanding of multi-jurisdiction AML/CTF regulatory obligations and reporting expectations.

• Demonstrated ability to perform data-driven investigations using SQL, blockchain analytics tools and other research techniques to extract investigative insights, identify suspicious behaviour and develop defensible conclusions.

• Strong investigative judgement and the ability to produce clear, structured long-form reports tailored to technical, compliance, leadership, and cross-functional audiences.

• Experience identifying financial crime typologies, contributing to proactive investigations and turning investigative findings into programme or control improvements.

• Utilises generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

About the Role

This is a mission-critical product leadership role at the heart of Crypto.com's regulated trading business. As Product Manager, Fiat & FCM, you will own the end-to-end fiat product strategy for our Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) and regulated US trading platform — the money-movement infrastructure that lets retail, private, and institutional clients fund and withdraw from a CFTC/NFA-regulated trading environment instantly, compliantly, and reliably.
FCM is one of Crypto.com's top growth priorities, and it's your anchor. But the mandate is broader: you'll own the banking-rail strategy that scales this model across markets and currencies, and over time, extends to Crypto.com's other business lines, defining which rails we use, which banks we partner with, how customer funds are segregated and settled, and how money moves in and out. You'll carry direct accountability for Total Funds Flow, acceptance rates, settlement speed, and cost-per-transaction across the platform.
Our team is globally distributed across APAC, EU, and US time zones, so you'll need to be comfortable working across time zones and communicate effectively with globally distributed teams.


Responsibilities
•

FCM Funding & Regulated Fund Handling: Own the fiat funding and withdrawal experience for the FCM platform, including customer fund segregation, margin funding flows, and the operational data behind daily segregation computation and regulatory reporting

•

Payment Rails: Select and integrate rails based on speed, reversibility, and cost - ACH, FedWire, FedNow/RTP in the US, and SEPA / SEPA Instant / FPS and other schemes as the platform grows across markets and currencies

•

B2B API & Developer Platform: Define and own the API surface for institutional and partner integrations - including API specs, sandbox environments, onboarding flows, and ongoing support for enterprise client integrations

•

Strategic Bank Partnerships: Lead assessments, commercial negotiations, and technical integrations for direct bank relationships that can support a regulated trading entity - securing preferential rates, dedicated service levels, segregated-account structures, and custom solutions. Includes exposure to specialized charters (e.g. SPDI) where relevant

•

Global Banking Network: Build and optimize payment infrastructure across markets, ensuring maximum rail coverage and uptime for fiat access - extending the FCM funding model to additional geographies over time

•

Liquidity & Settlement: Structure banking partnerships to maintain near-zero-downtime liquidity for mass user pay-outs and high-frequency trading settlement

•

Acceptance Rate Optimization: Drive improvements in pay-in acceptance across card and bank-transfer channels by optimizing processor relationships, fraud rules, and compliance logic

•

Payment Orchestration & Routing: Design and own the logic for a dynamic routing engine that selects the optimal rail in real time based on user segment, jurisdiction, currency, speed, and risk profile

•

Institutional On-Ramp: Build compliant, scalable fiat solutions for institutional trading clients - including segregated bank accounts, high-value wire processing, and bulk pay-out APIs

Requirements
•

Direct experience with a CFTC/NFA-regulated FCM, futures broker, or regulated trading platform - including familiarity with customer fund segregation, margin funding, and regulatory fund-handling obligations

•

Deep hands-on knowledge of payment rails across multiple markets - US (ACH, FedWire, FedNow/RTP) and ideally EU (SEPA, SEPA Instant) - including reversibility, settlement timing, and their trade-offs for a regulated trading business

•

Experience with direct bank integrations (not just white-label PSPs) and commercial partnership negotiation; exposure to specialized banking charters (e.g. SPDI) a strong plus

•

Experience building and launching scalable B2B API products - including API specs, developer-facing documentation, onboarding flows, and working with enterprise clients on integration requirements

•

7–10+ years of product management, with at least 5 years focused on payment infrastructure, core banking, or regulated trading/brokerage products

•

Demonstrated success building and scaling payment rails in a high-volume, real-time environment

•

Track record of leading payment orchestration and dynamic routing logic in production

•

Experience building fiat solutions for institutional clients (segregated accounts, wire processing, bulk APIs)

•

Technical acumen across complex API products, data flows, and payment-protocol integrations

•

Able to work across APAC, EU, and US time zones and communicate effectively with globally distributed teams

•

Strong people management - you develop and hold a high bar for your team

•

Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, legal, compliance, finance, and senior leadership

Purpose of Role / Summary:

The Senior Digital Marketing Specialist is responsible for the hands-on development, execution, management, and optimization of the company’s paid digital advertising strategy to generate qualified leads for its brokerage and trading services.

The role owns and manages Pay-Per-Click (PPC) activities across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, and other approved advertising channels. It is also responsible for advertising budgets, campaign setup, tracking, reporting, A/B testing, attribution, and conversion-rate optimization.

The position is accountable for improving campaign efficiency and customer-acquisition outcomes using key performance indicators including Cost per Click (CPC), Cost per Lead (CPL), Cost per Qualified Lead, Cost per Acquisition (CPA), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Investment

(ROI), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), lead quality, account-opening conversion rates, and funded-client conversion rates.

Main Activities and Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute PPC and performance marketing strategies aligned with brand awareness, qualified-lead generation, account openings, customer acquisition, retention, and business-growth objectives

• Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Search, Google Display Network, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, remarketing, and other approved digital advertising platforms

• Conduct keyword, search-term, audience, competitor, placement, and market analysis to identify acquisition opportunities and improve campaign performance

• Monitor and optimize CPC, CPM, CTR, CPL, cost per qualified lead, CPA, CAC, conversion rates, lead quality, ROI, and ROAS by adjusting budgets, bids, keywords, audiences, locations, devices, placements, frequency, creative assets, forms, and landing pages

• Reduce irrelevant traffic, invalid clicks, poor-quality placements, audience overlap, creative fatigue, and inefficient advertising spend; prepare corrective action plans for underperforming campaigns and scale successful campaigns while protecting lead quality and conversion performance

• Manage advertising budgets, pacing, forecasts, and spending allocations to maximize results and prevent overspending, underspending, or inefficient investment

In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are an exchange. The speed of good decisions matter in everything that we do. Our data domain is committed to making sure the decisions this business makes on spend, pricing, product, risk and financial crime rest on evidence rather than intuition. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality.



The Problems You'll Get to Solve

 - Growth & causal inference. Measure true incrementality, own our marketing mix model, and turn that into spend allocation under a budget.

 - Product & personalization. Rank and surface what is relevant to each customer's behaviour and holdings, from asset discovery to order form defaults, without drowning users in noise

 - Markets, pricing & execution. Model fee and spread elasticity to find the revenue-versus-volume trade-off, and improve execution quality: slippage, order routing, liquidity provider selection.

 - Risk & financial integrity. Model risk exposure across a volatile asset book, forecast liquidation risk, and detect reconciliation breaks across internal ledgers, on-chain data and partner reporting.

 - Financial crime & compliance. Detect account takeover, payment fraud and mule networks in real time, combining business rules and models that work together while staying explainable and auditable.



What You'll Be Doing

 - Own problems end to end: frame the question with the stakeholder, build the model or experiment, ship it, and follow it into production.

 - Work backwards from the decision. Start from what someone needs to decide and what it costs to get it wrong, not from the data that happens to be available.

 - Stay accountable for your models once they are live: monitoring, drift, retraining, and the day they start behaving differently.

 - Tell senior stakeholders things they do not want to hear, including that a campaign, a feature or a rule did not work.

 - Support your teammates in growing every day by setting the standard for how we do causal inference, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge.



What We Look For

 - Strong applied experience turning a messy business question into a model or a measurement: causal inference where that fits, predictive and ranking models where it does not. You know when a result is not real.

 - Fluency in Python and SQL, and comfort working independently rather than waiting for data to be handed to you. We use Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Looker, on top of technologies like MySQL, Druid, Kafka and Flink.

 - A track record of models that made it into production and changed a decision, not just notebooks and slide decks.

 - Sound statistical judgement, and the honesty to quantify and communicate uncertainty rather than hide it.

 - Exceptional communication skills. We expect you to talk to various stakeholders to derive requirements, drive discussions, and facilitate decision-making processes effectively.

 - Extraordinary sense of ownership. We are committed to empowering people with freedom and accountability.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience building with agentic tooling such as MCP or agent frameworks, or automation platforms like n8n.

Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions.

Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate.

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.






THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.




Kraken Pro is where serious traders work. Tight spreads, deep books, an API people actually build on. The people who use it are demanding, opinionated, and allergic to marketing.




We want someone who belongs in that room. Not a brand account with a person behind it, but a trader's trader who happens to be very good at building community.




Come here to build and grow this Community for us.




THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Live in the trenches. Discord, Telegram, X, TradingView, Reddit, the group chats you're already in at 3am. You're not "monitoring channels". You're a participant, with standing.

 - Be the fastest voice in the room. When a chain halts, a listing drops, or the market goes vertical, you're posting before the screenshots start circulating. Speed with accuracy, not vibes.

 - Build the inner circle. Stand up an ambassador and power-user program: the market makers, quant desks, and high-volume traders who'll tell you the truth about the product. Give them a reason to stay loud.

 - Run the room in public. AMAs, live trading sessions, feature launches, competitions, post-mortems when we get something wrong. Own the format, don't just attend it.

 - Close the loop with Product. You'll be the first to hear that the order entry flow is broken. Your job is to get it to the PM with receipts, then go back and tell the community what happened.

 - Write things people screenshot. Threads on microstructure, teardowns of new features, release notes that don't read like release notes.

 - Prove it worked. Sentiment, share of voice, community-sourced signups, retention of the accounts that matter. You bring the numbers to the table before anyone asks.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - You trade. Actual positions, actual scars. You can hold a conversation about funding rates, maker/taker economics, slippage, and latency without reaching for a glossary.

 - 3+ years running community or social for a product with a technical, skeptical audience. Crypto, fintech, gaming, or dev tools all count.

 - You write fast and well. Short-form that lands, long-form that holds up under scrutiny from people smarter than the average follower.

 - You have thick skin and good instincts. Crypto community management means getting yelled at with an audience watching. You de-escalate without going corporate and you know when to push back.

 - You've built something from a standing start, not just maintained an existing account.

 - You operate without a brief. Markets don't wait for approval chains, and neither should you… because you know where the line is and you don't need a committee to find it.

 - You're comfortable with the ambiguity of a company that ships constantly and reorganizes around opportunity.



Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.




OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.


We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.


As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.



Stay connected

Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/krakenfx

Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address

Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/

Job Description
The Head Controlling & Risk leads the Controlling & Risk department and oversees a multidisciplinary team of approximately 20 employees organised across specialised risks The role is responsible for ensuring that credit, market, liquidity, operational and related regulatory risks are identified, monitored, challenged and reported across the Group in line with the risk appetite defined by the Board of Directors.
The role also oversees the Group’s internal control framework, ensuring that key controls, governance standards and related documentation remain effective, consistent and appropriately monitored.
Key Responsibilities
•
Leadership and department management: define the department’s priorities and operating model; lead, coach and develop managers and teams; ensure effective resource allocation and continuous upskilling.
•
Risk governance and reporting: produce and present clear reports for the Risk Committee, Executive Management and the Board of Directors; ensure adequate escalation of material risk developments, incidents, KRIs and remediation actions.
•
Risk framework ownership: maintain and continuously improve the Group risk management and internal control frameworks, including policies, methodologies, risk appetite monitoring, risk taxonomy, controls and reporting standards; draft, review and update risk policies, procedures and governance documents; support the development of structured approached to assess risk culture, control effectiveness and internal control maturity
The Head Controlling & Risk provides strategic direction and effective challenge across the following areas, acting as the senior point of contact for C&R teams, other internal stakeholders, governance bodies and regulators on Controlling & Risk matters:
•
Credit, market and liquidity risks – own investments: oversee concentration analysis, limit monitoring, stress testing, RWA, capital & liquidity planning and related risk indicators.
•
Credit and market risks – client activities: oversee the monitoring of clients active in ETD trading, lending and eFX trading, including trading conditions, margin parameters, daily margin call analysis, stress testing and market watch.
•
Operational risk management: oversee the identification, assessment, monitoring and reporting of operational risks, excluding dedicated IT and AML topics where separate specialised functions exist; coordinate the RCSA framework, KRIs, incidents and action management monitoring.
•
Reconciliation activities: supervise the reconciliation of cash, securities and cryptocurrencies with external counterparties and custodians, ensuring timely escalation and remediation of discrepancies.
•
Consolidated supervision: contribute to Group-level oversight by ensuring consistent risk standards, reporting and escalation across relevant entities and activities.
•
Regulatory relations: liaise with FINMA, SIX and other relevant stakeholders on Controlling & Risk topics, and oversee alignment with applicable regulatory requirements.

• In-scope products and activities: mainstream securities, including bonds, equities, structured products and precious metals; exchange-traded derivatives; cryptocurrencies and digital assets; eFX and interbank FX products, including CFDs on multiple underlyings, spot and forward FX.

Master's degree in a relevant field; a recognised professional qualification in risk, internal controls, audit or finance (e.g. FRM, PRM, CIA, CRMA, CISA or CFA) is strongly preferred.

10+ years of experience in a leadership position in banking, financial services, risk management or a related field, including substantial leadership experience, ideally within a regulated and international financial institution.

Strong strategic leadership and experience managing multidisciplinary expert teams.
•
Broad expertise in credit, market, liquidity and operational risk within a banking environment.
•
Solid knowledge of Swiss banking regulation, FINMA expectations and Basel standards, ideally within a Category 3 bank.
•
Strong strategic thinking, business acumen and judgement.
•
Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with the ability to balance risk, business growth and operational efficiency.

Strong communication, presentation and writing skills, including risk reports, policies and Board-level materials

Confident constructive challenger, with high integrity, independence and credibility.
•
Technology-minded, with a strong interest in digitalisation, data and AI.

Additional assets: Understanding of ICT, cyber and data-security risks. Experience with GRC platforms, RCSA, KRI and incident management workflows. Quantitative/model risk and stress-testing expertise. Data science, AI and automation applied to risk monitoring and reporting.

• Help build out Topstep's mobile MVP in React Native and TypeScript, integrating with GraphQL APIs across our trader and trading experiences.

• Own mobile features end-to-end, from technical design through App Store and Play Store releases, monitoring, and iteration.

• Partner with product and design to translate trader needs into intuitive, accessible experiences that balance user experience with technical constraints and platform capabilities.

• Bring mobile expertise into cross-functional feature teams as the product grows, helping teams deliver mobile features confidently.

Eightcap operates at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and global financial markets. Headquartered in Melbourne with a global footprint spanning the UK, Cyprus, and Bulgaria, we build the high-performance infrastructure that connects the world to CFD markets - reliably, securely and with precision.
We're after an engineer who treats infrastructure as software: versioned, reviewed, tested and released. Someone who is as comfortable reviewing a Terraform pull request as they are tracing a production latency spike, and who leaves every codebase, pipeline and security posture better than they found it. The Senior Cloud / DevOps Engineer will own the health, security and evolution of the AWS estate that our trading services, client-facing applications and internal systems run on.
To drive real impact in this role, you will:
• Own the Cloud Platform: Design, build and operate our multi-account AWS environments, with Terraform as the backbone for every change, from modules to drift detection to plan-and-review.
• Build the Paved Road: Own CI/CD in GitHub Actions and build boilerplates for .NET, Go and Python so teams can ship standardised, production-ready environments with minimal friction.
• Engineer Security In: Apply least-privilege IAM, secrets management, network controls and CSPM tooling like Wiz, and embed scanning and policy-as-code directly into pipelines.
• Automate Compliance: Build continuous evidence and controls against SOC 2, ISO 27001 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework, so audit readiness is always on, not a scramble.
• Own Observability and Reliability: Run the CloudWatch stack, define SLOs, lead incident response and post-incident reviews, and keep runbooks sharp enough for another engineer to follow.
• Lead Without the Title: Set platform standards, review infrastructure and pipeline changes from other engineers, mentor the team on cloud and security practice and help shape the roadmap.
• Partner Across the Business: Work closely with Infrastructure and Security, Product Engineering squads and Trading Platform Operations to keep the estate secure, resilient and easy to build on.
Requirements
What You'll Bring:
• Significant hands-on experience designing, building and operating production AWS workloads, including multi-account setups, VPC networking, IAM, EC2, Lambda, Fargate, RDS and CloudWatch.
• Expert-level Terraform, including authoring reusable modules, managing remote state and refactoring live infrastructure without downtime.

Job Summary

Uphold is looking for Marketing Technology Manager, CRM Platform a to take full ownership of Customer.io, the platform we use to communicate with millions of customers across email, push, in-app and SMS.

This is a technical role, not a campaign execution role. You will own the data model, the integrations, the workflow architecture and the operating standards that make customer communication possible at scale. You will sit between Engineering, Data, Marketing and Commercial, and you will be the person who decides how the platform is built and how it is used.

The scope is wide. Uphold runs multiple products and regions on shared infrastructure, in a highly regulated industry, with a large volume of personal data. Getting this right means designing for reuse, for auditability and for safety, not just for the next campaign.

What you’ll be doing primarily

Own the CRM data foundation

• Own the data layer inside Customer.io: Define and maintain the objects, attributes, events and identifiers that power the platform. Segmentation quality is a direct function of data quality, so this is the core of the role.

• Work hand in hand with Engineering and Data: Design and maintain the pipelines that feed Customer.io. Agree on schemas, event contracts and data freshness requirements, and hold the line when they drift.

• Guarantee freshness and correctness: Put monitoring and alerting in place so that stale, missing or malformed data is caught before it reaches a customer, not after.

Architect workflows that last

• Apply systems thinking to campaign design: Build journeys, triggers and segments that are modular, reusable and understandable by someone who did not build them.

• Prevent workflow sprawl: Establish naming conventions, versioning, documentation and deprecation routines. Retire what is no longer used. Treat the CRM workspace as a codebase, not a folder of one off campaigns.

• Design for scale: Anticipate volume, message throughput, rate limits and platform constraints before they become production issues.

Operate with a multi product and multi brand mindset

• Serve several products and brands from one platform: Design workspace structure, data models and templates so that Wallet, Topper, Enterprise and future brands share what should be shared and separate what must be separated.

• Balance consistency with autonomy: Give each product team room to move without letting the overall architecture fragment.

• Manage cross brand message pressure: Own global frequency capping, priority rules and suppression logic so customers receive a coherent experience across products.

Translate business objectives into CRM capability

• Partner with Marketing and Commercial: Understand what the business is trying to achieve, then decide what the platform needs to look like to support it. Push back when a request is better solved a different way.

• Turn requirements into architecture: Convert commercial goals into concrete data, segmentation and workflow design, with clear trade offs and sequencing.

• Own the roadmap for the platform: Maintain a prioritised view of platform work and communicate it to stakeholders.

Enable marketing autonomy

• Build for self sufficiency: Create templates, reusable components, documented segments and clear guardrails so marketing teams can launch routine work without engineering support.

• Train and document: Run enablement sessions and maintain practical documentation. Success is measured by how much the teams can do without you, not by how much depends on you.

• Set the guardrails: Define what marketers can change freely, what needs review, and what is locked. Make the safe path the easy path.

Drive automation and AI adoption

• Identify automation opportunities: Look for manual, repetitive or error prone steps across the CRM operation and remove them.

• Apply AI where it earns its place: Evaluate and implement AI for content generation, send time and channel optimisation, segmentation, anomaly detection and QA. Be pragmatic about where it adds value and where it does not.

• Keep improving the operation: Measure the cycle time from business request to live campaign, and work it down.

Security and data protection first

• Treat personal data with care: This is a PII heavy environment. Apply data minimisation, least privilege access, retention rules and clear handling standards by default.

• Own consent and preferences: Maintain the consent, opt out and preference model, and make sure it is respected consistently across every channel and every brand.

• Support compliance and audit: Work with Security, Privacy, Compliance and Legal on GDPR, access reviews, vendor risk and audit evidence. Be able to explain who received what, when, and on what basis.

• Respect jurisdictional rules: Uphold operates under multiple regulatory regimes. Build the targeting and suppression logic that keeps communications compliant by market, including mandatory risk warnings and geographic restrictions on financial promotions.

Protect quality at the customer touchpoint

• Be detail and quality obsessed: Every message is a direct customer touchpoint and a reflection of the brand. Own the QA process, including test sends, seed lists, rendering checks, link validation and pre send review.

• Own deliverability: Manage domain and IP reputation, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), warm up, list hygiene, bounce and complaint rates. Deliverability is an engineering problem, and it belongs to this role.

• Run change management: Define approval gates, no send windows, rollback procedures and incident response for communication failures.

• Measure and improve: Own experimentation design, holdout groups and performance reporting, in partnership with the Data team.

Required Qualifications and Skills

• BS or advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

• 4+ years of experience in the field, with meaningful time spent owning a marketing automation, CRM or customer engagement platform in a technical capacity.

• Hands-on experience with Customer.io, or a comparable platform such as Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, at an architecture and administration level rather than campaign execution only.

• Strong SQL and comfort working with data warehouses and modern data pipelines.

• Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, event driven data models and identity resolution.

• Working knowledge of templating languages such as Liquid, plus HTML, CSS and JavaScript for email and in-app content.

• Demonstrated systems thinking: the ability to design maintainable, scalable structures rather than solve each request in isolation.

• Experience working with personal data under a security and privacy first approach, including consent management and GDPR.

• Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non technical audiences.

• Comfortable working across functions with Marketing, Commercial, Product, Data and Engineering.

• Strong sense of ownership, accountability and attention to detail.

• Fluent written and oral English.

Salary: $150K + Bonus, Benefits

• Experience running CRM across multiple products or brands from a single platform.

As a Transaction Monitoring Investigator, you will play a critical role in safeguarding the integrity of the Bitfinex platform by identifying, investigating, and mitigating financial crime risks across both fiat and cryptocurrency transactions. Working within the Compliance team, you will analyze transaction monitoring alerts, assess unusual account activity, and investigate potential money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions, and fraud-related risks using a risk-based approach. You will collaborate closely with AML Investigators, Product teams, and Compliance leadership to ensure timely escalation of high-risk cases, contribute to regulatory reporting and process improvements, and continuously enhance monitoring controls. This role requires strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and a deep interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain transactions, and evolving AML/KYC regulations within a fast-paced global fintech environment.

Your Day-to-Day:
•
Develop and implement transaction monitoring algorithms to monitor for anti-money laundering, terrorism financing, sanctions and other compliance risks to enable controls to be implemented to mitigate against detected risks using a risk-based approach.
•
Analyze and investigate alerts generated by the transaction monitoring system arising from fiat money (wire and non-wire) and crypto (on-chain and off-chain) trades, deposits and withdrawals with a view to mitigate risk exposure to the platform, and escalate real time urgent alerts according to risk appetite.
•
Assist the Manager Transaction Monitoring in building periodic specific and general reports providing analysis that identifies ML, TF and Sanctions related anomalies for the information of the Chief Compliance Officer and relevant Product Managers.
•
As a member of the Transaction Monitoring Team, report directly to the Manager of Transaction Monitoring. Also, work closely with other Bitfinex teams and peer AML Investigators in addressing both fraud, and money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions risks.
•
In performing this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including the application of virtual currencies, documentation requirements, and account behavior analysis in the context of KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions.
•
Duties include understanding the framework of our transaction monitoring rules on a risk-based approach as well as analyzing and evaluating data needed to assess referrals of unusual transaction activities.
•
Ensure that KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions activities are observed at all times, issues are addressed appropriately, and matters escalated to management as required. Further, identification and/or coordination of the implementation of process improvements relating to KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions policies in conjunction with Bitfiex’s ToS as applicable are also imperative.

This role’s Tactical Responsibilities also include:

•
Initial assessment of referrals of unusual transaction activity
•
Report and analyze unusual documentation and/or information and/or query and/or transaction to/with Manager Investigations and Transaction Monitoring
•
Adjust risk parameters to ensure exposure falls within the platform’s risk appetite
•
Participate in applicable compliance training;
•
Follow and implement KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions-related policies, laws and regulations.
•
Carry out cross-departmental communication when the need arises.
•
Liaise with AML Analysts and/or users in respect of additional information required in order to verify the presence of ML/TF concerns when required.
•
Undertake evaluation and communicate findings and decisions to respective case stream team leader; escalate and/or discuss with the Head of Investigations where required.

What You Bring to the Table:
•
Experience in the compliance field within the Industry;
•
Fair understanding or ability to understand AML/KYC/CTF related policies, laws and regulations, including enhanced due diligence, (CDD/EDD) and Sanctions;
•
Basic knowledge of blockchain technology, (enhanced in the role); CAMS/CBP designation
•
​​Experience with a Blockchain Analytical/Transaction Monitoring tool such as Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM, etc.
•
University degree
•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
•
Ability to source and understand the content of documentation in various languages, types and forms
•
Demonstrated critical thinking and decision-making skills
•
Demonstrated attention to detail, accuracy and consistency

Self-motivated (ability to take initiative)
•
Proficient IT skills (Chrome, Open Search, Google Docs, Gmail, Word, Excel, etc.)

Organisational understanding (enhanced in the role)

The Role:
As a Transaction Monitoring Investigator, you will play a critical role in safeguarding the integrity of the Bitfinex platform by identifying, investigating, and mitigating financial crime risks across both fiat and cryptocurrency transactions. Working within the Compliance team, you will analyze transaction monitoring alerts, assess unusual account activity, and investigate potential money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions, and fraud-related risks using a risk-based approach. You will collaborate closely with AML Investigators, Product teams, and Compliance leadership to ensure timely escalation of high-risk cases, contribute to regulatory reporting and process improvements, and continuously enhance monitoring controls. This role requires strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and a deep interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain transactions, and evolving AML/KYC regulations within a fast-paced global fintech environment.

Your Day-to-Day:
•
Develop and implement transaction monitoring algorithms to monitor for anti-money laundering, terrorism financing, sanctions and other compliance risks to enable controls to be implemented to mitigate against detected risks using a risk-based approach.
•
Analyze and investigate alerts generated by the transaction monitoring system arising from fiat money (wire and non-wire) and crypto (on-chain and off-chain) trades, deposits and withdrawals with a view to mitigate risk exposure to the platform, and escalate real time urgent alerts according to risk appetite.
•
Assist the Manager Transaction Monitoring in building periodic specific and general reports providing analysis that identifies ML, TF and Sanctions related anomalies for the information of the Chief Compliance Officer and relevant Product Managers.
•
As a member of the Transaction Monitoring Team, report directly to the Manager of Transaction Monitoring. Also, work closely with other Bitfinex teams and peer AML Investigators in addressing both fraud, and money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions risks.
•
In performing this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including the application of virtual currencies, documentation requirements, and account behavior analysis in the context of KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions.
•
Duties include understanding the framework of our transaction monitoring rules on a risk-based approach as well as analyzing and evaluating data needed to assess referrals of unusual transaction activities.
•
Ensure that KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions activities are observed at all times, issues are addressed appropriately, and matters escalated to management as required. Further, identification and/or coordination of the implementation of process improvements relating to KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions policies in conjunction with Bitfiex’s ToS as applicable are also imperative.

This role’s Tactical Responsibilities also include:

•
Initial assessment of referrals of unusual transaction activity
•
Report and analyze unusual documentation and/or information and/or query and/or transaction to/with Manager Investigations and Transaction Monitoring
•
Adjust risk parameters to ensure exposure falls within the platform’s risk appetite
•
Participate in applicable compliance training;
•
Follow and implement KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions-related policies, laws and regulations.
•
Carry out cross-departmental communication when the need arises.
•
Liaise with AML Analysts and/or users in respect of additional information required in order to verify the presence of ML/TF concerns when required.
•
Undertake evaluation and communicate findings and decisions to respective case stream team leader; escalate and/or discuss with the Head of Investigations where required.

What You Bring to the Table:
•
Experience in the compliance field within the Industry;
•
Fair understanding or ability to understand AML/KYC/CTF related policies, laws and regulations, including enhanced due diligence, (CDD/EDD) and Sanctions;
•
Basic knowledge of blockchain technology, (enhanced in the role); CAMS/CBP designation
•
​​Experience with a Blockchain Analytical/Transaction Monitoring tool such as Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM, etc.
•
University degree
•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
•
Ability to source and understand the content of documentation in various languages, types and forms
•
Demonstrated critical thinking and decision-making skills
•
Demonstrated attention to detail, accuracy and consistency
•
Self-motivated (ability to take initiative)
•
Proficient IT skills (Chrome, Open Search, Google Docs, Gmail, Word, Excel, etc.)

Organisational understanding (enhanced in the role)

TM Framework & Policy

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.


We're looking for a Head of Exchange Infrastructure to own the layer every Kraken product is built on: the matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, the algo engine and the API engine. Kraken grew up as a set of vertically integrated products, each with its own engine and its own APIs. This role consolidates them into a single exchange stack that serves every product and every interface. You will lead a team of four to five product managers, partnered with an engineering manager. It is a senior, independent team, which means you get leverage quickly and you are expected to stay close to the work.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the product vision and roadmap for the exchange layer: matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, algo engine and API engine

 - Lead and grow a team of four to five product managers, and set the bar for product craft across the layer

 - Lead the consolidation of multiple matching engines into one, starting with US derivatives, then international derivatives, then spot

 - Build interface-agnostic, so every product team and every interface can build on the same platform rather than their own

 - Define success metrics (p99 latency, throughput, uptime, resiliency) and hold teams accountable to them

 - Partner with engineering leaders across exchange and core infrastructure to sequence the migration without disrupting live markets

 - Partner with Risk and Credit Infrastructure so a client can hold one account and trade every product against it

 - Anticipate industry shifts and shape our platform to stay ahead

 - Align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, risk, compliance) around the exchange strategy

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Senior product leader with experience in exchange, trading, or high-performance platforms

 - Experience managing and developing product managers, on a team senior enough to run without you in the room

 - Happy to be a player-coach. This team is independent, so you will own roadmaps and write specs yourself at times, not only review them

 - Proven ability to set product vision and translate it into a long-term roadmap

 - Strong understanding of matching engine and market data architecture, and the tradeoffs low latency forces

 - Experience building platforms for internal customers, with the judgment to tell a platform from a series of bespoke builds

 - Excellent communication skills — can influence technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - A passion for crypto markets, market structure, and building the next generation of infrastructure

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Engineering background before moving into product, so you've built or operated high-performance systems yourself and not just specced them

 - Experience across both spot and derivatives venues, with the market structure differences that come with each

 - Time at a crypto exchange operating at comparable scale, volume and uptime expectations

 - Track record building platform roadmaps that interlock with adjacent product orgs rather than running in isolation







Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.




OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.


We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.


As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe crypto will help reshape the future and contribute to greater individual freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions of customers access to crypto trading and decentralised applications. OKX is also trusted by institutions seeking secure access to crypto markets and is supported by its Proof of Reserves programme.

Across our global offices, we are united by three core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These values shape how we work and help us create a collaborative, rewarding and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Team

The Compliance function is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the safe, sustainable growth of OKX. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on regulatory obligations, conduct expectations and enterprise risks.

OKX Europe Markets Limited operates within a significant EU regulatory perimeter as a MiFID II investment firm authorised under the Investment Services Act (Cap. 370), providing dealing on own account and execution of orders on behalf of clients on a matched-principal basis, together with trustee, custodian and nominee services, across the EEA on a cross-border services passport. Our product range includes crypto-asset perpetuals and expiry futures, single stock and ETF-linked futures, commodity futures and crypto-asset options, and is expanding into money market fund and structured product offerings.

About the Opportunity

As the Senior Compliance Analyst for OKX Europe Markets Limited, you will deliver the day-to-day operational compliance work of a fast-growing MiFID II investment firm: financial promotions review, complaints administration, regulatory and trade reporting support, monitoring testing and the firm's regulatory registers.

This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. The function reviews in the order of seventeen pieces of marketing and promotional material each week and handles around five new complaints each week, both scaling with a client base that is growing towards 100,000 users, alongside recurring regulatory reporting, token-listing and licence-extension assessments and compliance monitoring testing. You will be the person who keeps that machinery running accurately and on time.

You will gain broad exposure to MFSA supervision and EU financial services regulation, and direct visibility of how a MiFID II derivatives business is controlled in practice.

The position reports to the Deputy Head of Compliance, with a secondary reporting line to the Head of Compliance and MLRO, OKX Europe Markets Limited.

What You'll Be Doing

You will:

•

Review client-facing marketing material and financial promotions for compliance with MiFID II fair, clear and not misleading standards and the MFSA advertisement rules, across paid and organic social, email, landing pages, banners, push notifications, video and KOL briefs, and prepare them for approval by the Deputy Head of Compliance or the Head of Compliance.

•

Maintain the advertisement and marketing approval register, tracking each item from submission through amendment to approval, and supporting notifications to the MFSA where required.

•

Administer the end-to-end complaints process: logging and triage, investigation, preparation of customer responses within regulatory deadlines, remediation follow-up and escalation of significant or recurring issues to the Deputy Head of Compliance.

•

Produce complaints management information, root-cause and trend analysis to support the function's reporting to senior management, the Risk, Compliance and Audit Committee and the Board.

•

Support trade and transaction reporting obligations, including data collection and validation, regulatory return preparation, review and sign-off coordination, submission and evidence retention.

•

Conduct scheduled and ad-hoc testing under the Compliance Monitoring Programme, document findings, track remediation actions to closure and maintain the monitoring calendar.

•

Prepare token-listing and licence-extension assessments and supporting documentation for review, and support new product and feature compliance reviews and local launch sign-off.

•

Maintain the firm's core regulatory registers — regulatory correspondence, breaches, advertisements and the regulatory obligation register — ensuring an accurate, audit-ready flow of information to the MFSA and internal stakeholders.

•

Draft and update compliance policies, procedures and entity-specific addenda for review and approval, in line with regulatory developments.

•

Support regulatory-change horizon scanning, recording applicable changes against the obligation register and flagging implementation requirements.

•

Handle first-line queries on compliance and AML/CFT matters, escalating appropriately, and support responses to legal, regulatory and law-enforcement requests.

•

Support the retained AML/CFT work of the entity, including quality assurance sampling, high-risk onboarding and client-classification approvals, and internal and external audit support.

•

Support the preparation of compliance reports and Board and committee materials, and other materials required by internal stakeholders.

•

Work closely with teams such as Data, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Product and Risk to embed an effective compliance framework aligned with MFSA and EU standards.

What We Look For in You

•

Prior experience in a compliance, legal, regulatory or regulatory-operations role within financial services, investment firms, fintech or the crypto-asset sector.

•

Sound understanding of the MFSA regulatory framework, MiFID II conduct-of-business requirements and EU financial services regulation.

•

Demonstrable ability to handle a high, recurring caseload to deadline without loss of quality, and to prioritise between competing regulatory deadlines.

•

High attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accurate, complete and audit-ready records and registers.

•

Strong analytical ability, with the capacity to assess regulatory obligations against material or a process, identify gaps and produce well-reasoned written analysis.

•

Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey compliance requirements to non-specialist colleagues and to draft customer-facing responses.

•

Strong organisational skills, able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and meet regulatory deadlines.

•

Comfortable operating with limited supervision, exercising judgement within a defined framework and escalating appropriately.

•

A bachelor's degree in law, finance, business administration or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

•

Professional fluency in English.

Nice to Have

•

Experience reviewing or approving financial promotions or marketing material in a regulated firm.

•

Experience administering a regulated complaints process.

•

Experience with trade or transaction reporting, or with compliance monitoring and control testing.

•

Experience working in Malta or with the Malta Financial Services Authority.

•

Familiarity with derivatives conduct topics such as leverage and margin, appropriateness and suitability, client categorisation and best execution.

•

A relevant professional qualification from the International Compliance Association, ACAMS or an equivalent body, or progress towards one.

•

Knowledge of and genuine enthusiasm for the crypto and digital-assets industry.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package.

•

Learning and development programmes and an education subsidy.

•

Team-building programmes and company events.

•

Wellness and meal allowances.

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants.

•

Additional benefits that we would be pleased to discuss during the recruitment process.
