OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"

Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.

We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:

•

A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.

•

A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.

This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.

This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.

What You’ll Be Doing

You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.

Own the agentic translation system

Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.

Build the agentic QA and quality automation

Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.

Make it self-improving

Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.

In this role, you will join a team of 5 members, including the Head of Operational Risk, based across our offices in Warsaw and Krakow. Capital Adequacy & ICAAP / ICARA
•
Calculate and monitor daily regulatory capital consumption under the IFR/IFD framework (Pillar 1 K-Factors, FOR, PMCR).

Design and execute the annual ICAAP/ICARA process, developing quantitative stress-testing engines calibrated to CFD market shocks.
•
Model capital velocity and trajectory across trading cycles, establishing early-warning triggers and capital escalation protocols.

Market Risk & Hedging Controls
•
Define, calibrate, and enforce market risk limits (NOP, VaR, Expected Shortfall, Greeks) across all CFD asset classes.
•
Automate daily K-NPR calculations across proprietary books and residual B-Book inventory.

Reconcile end-of-day positions against automated A-Book hedging feeds, challenging latency, execution slippage, and basis risk.

Credit, Counterparty & Concentration Risk

Track daily Trading Counterparty Default (K-TCD) and K-Concentration risk (K-CON) across active counterparties, clearing houses, and prime brokers.
•
Formulate credit due diligence frameworks for foreign Prime Brokers and Tier-1 LPs, monitoring margin utilization and collateral haircuts.
•
Stress-test firm liabilities arising from statutory Negative Balance Protection (NBP) and extreme market gap events.

Liquidity Risk & ILAAP
•
Ensure continuous compliance with IFR liquid asset buffer requirements covering the Fixed Overhead Requirement.
•
Lead the design, execution, and annual updates of the Internal Liquidity Adequacy Assessment Process (ILAAP).
•
Act as 2nd Line control over intraday cash sweeps and segregated client money accounts in line with KNF regulations.\

Supervisory & Regulatory Reporting
•
Own quantitative calculations and data verification for regulatory returns submitted to KNF and EBA under IFR ITS.

Prepare technical documentation and defend capital calculation methodologies during KNF SREP examinations.

Ensure end-to-end data lineage from raw trade logs to supervisory returns, aligning with updated EBA RTS and UKNF guidelines.

Min. 5 years of experience in quantitative financial risk management but impact matters more than years.

Deep hands-on knowledge of Regulation (EU) 2019/2033 and Directive (EU) 2019/2034, including precise calculation of K-Factors (K-NPR, K-TCD, K-CON).

Expert-level understanding of market and credit risk measurement techniques (VaR, Monte Carlo, Expected Shortfall).

Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced Country Manager to lead the end-to-end launch and growth of our Forex trading application in the assigned country.

This role is responsible for developing and executing the country strategy, establishing clear performance targets, driving customer acquisition and revenue growth, and ensuring successful application adoption in the local market. The Country Manager will oversee Customer Support operations nationwide and ensure that all commercial, marketing, customer, and operational activities comply with applicable local laws, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.

The position will serve as the key decisionmaker for the country and work closely with regional and global teams across Product, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, Payments, Technology, Compliance, and Legal.

Key Responsibilities
Application Launch and Market Growth
• Lead the end-to-end launch of the Forex trading application in the assigned country.
• Develop and execute the country go-to-market strategy, launch plan, customer proposition, and growth roadmap.
• Ensure all functions are operationally ready before launch, including Product, Marketing, Payments, Customer Support, Operations, Compliance, and Technology.
• Drive customer acquisition, application registrations, KYC completion, first-time deposits, active trading, retention, and revenue growth.
• Identify target customer segments, market opportunities, suitable acquisition channels, and local growth initiatives.
• Monitor competitor applications, product features, pricing, promotions, customer journeys, and market positioning.
• Develop post-launch action plans to improve application adoption, customer engagement, and sustainable business growth.
Country Performance Management
• Establish clear country-level commercial, operational, and customer-service performance targets.
• Define KPIs for customer acquisition, KYC conversion, first-time deposits, active traders, trading volume, revenue, retention, and customer satisfaction.
• Set clear targets and accountabilities for all local teams and relevant supporting functions.
• Monitor country performance through daily, weekly, and monthly dashboards.
• Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action or recovery plans.
• Manage country budgets, forecasts, commercial expenditure, and P&L performance where applicable.
• Provide regular performance reports, market insights, risks, and recommendations to regional and global management.
Customer Support and Customer Experience
• Oversee the overall Customer Support operation across the country.
• Establish service standards and performance targets for response time, resolution time, service quality, complaint handling, and customer satisfaction.
• Ensure customers receive accurate, timely, professional, and compliant support.
• Coordinate with Operations, Payments, Technology, and Compliance to resolve issues involving account opening, KYC, deposits, withdrawals, trading, application access, and technical incidents.
• Review customer feedback, complaints, and service data to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities.
• Ensure serious, sensitive, or regulatory complaints are escalated and resolved through the appropriate process.
• Drive continuous improvement of the end-to-end customer journey and application experience.
Product and Operational Management
• Act as the primary representative of the local market to regional and global Product teams.
• Provide market insights and recommend product features, payment methods, campaigns, and customer-journey improvements.
• Ensure the application, onboarding process, payment journey, customer communications, and promotional materials are appropriately localized.
• Monitor application performance, onboarding drop-off, payment success rates, service interruptions, and operational issues.
• Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve product and operational issues within agreed timelines.
• Ensure appropriate business-continuity and incident-management plans are in place.
Compliance, Legal, and Country Governance
• Work closely with Compliance and Legal to ensure that all country activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, and internal governance requirements.
• Ensure appropriate controls are applied to customer onboarding, KYC/AML, payment activities, marketing campaigns, promotions, customer communications, and complaint handling.
• Monitor regulatory and legal developments relating to Forex trading, financial services, advertising, data privacy, consumer protection, and electronic transactions.
• Assess the business impact of regulatory changes and coordinate implementation of required actions.
• Ensure all required approvals, documents, records, and audit trails are properly maintained.
• Escalate potential regulatory breaches, fraud indicators, customer-protection concerns, operational risks, or reputational risks.
• Ensure that business growth and revenue targets do not compromise compliance obligations or customer protection.
Leadership and Cross-Functional Coordination
• Lead country-level business execution and ensure alignment between Commercial, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, Product, Compliance, and Legal.
• Translate company objectives into clear team targets, responsibilities, and deliverables.
• Conduct regular performance reviews and address underperformance through structured action plans.
• Build a high-performance and accountable country team.
• Manage local vendors, payment providers, service providers, and other operational partners.
• Represent the company with external stakeholders and relevant authorities when formally authorized.
• Lead the country response to critical customer, operational, regulatory, or reputational incidents.

Requirements

Mandatory
• Proven track record of launching or scaling a digital consumer business, managing measurable commercial outcomes, and leading cross-functional execution. Direct Forex/CFD experience is preferred but not required.
• At least 3 years of experience in country management, commercial leadership, growth, product commercialization, or senior business operations.
• Proven experience launching or scaling a digital application or trading platform.
• Strong understanding of the Forex customer lifecycle, including registration, KYC, deposits, trading activity, withdrawals, retention, and reactivation.
• Proven ability to establish performance targets and manage results through data, KPIs, budgets, forecasts, and P&L indicators.
• Practical experience overseeing Customer Support or customer operations at country or regional level.
• Good understanding of KYC/AML, customer protection, marketing governance, data privacy, complaint handling, and relevant financial-services regulations.
• Strong commercial judgment with the ability to balance revenue objectives against compliance, legal, operational, and reputational risks.
• Strong leadership, analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.
• Ability to work effectively with local, regional, and global teams in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred
• Experience managing a regulated Forex or CFD trading application in the relevant country.
• Experience working with Product, Technology, Payments, Marketing, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and Customer Support teams.
• Strong understanding of application analytics, customer funnels, CRM, payment conversion, and customer-retention strategies.
• Experience managing application launches, regulatory changes, operational incidents, or large-scale growth projects.
• Strong knowledge of the local fintech, payments, and digital-trading market.
Language
• Fluency in the local language of the assigned country.
• Strong professional English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. The Pro Verifications team decides whether a business signing up on the Pro side is who it says it is, and whether we're allowed to onboard it. That means figuring out who actually owns the business, running it against sanctions and watchlists, and doing all of it fast enough that a real customer doesn't lose patience and leave. Every Pro customer hits these systems, so slow or wrong is very visible — and the team is early, which means whoever joins gets to decide how a lot of it works instead of inheriting it.

How We Work

 - We deploy constantly, almost always behind a flag, in pieces small enough to pull back fast.

 - Security and compliance show up at design time, not as a gate at the end.

 - Every story is tied to a metric it's meant to move — if work isn't on the board, it doesn't get staffed.

 - At this level, you're expected to shape these standards, not just work inside them.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Engineer on Pro Verifications, you'll own the technical direction for how verification is built here — the architecture, the patterns other engineers work inside, and the calls about what we own versus what we lean on a vendor for. You'll be hands-on across the stack, drive out entire classes of recurring failure rather than patching them one at a time, and design the fail-closed and audit behavior that keeps regulators satisfied.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role for engineers who've built where being wrong has real consequences, and who want to shape a system that stays fast, safe, and defensible as it grows.

 - Set the shape of the verification services and their contracts across the KYC/KYB flow.

 - Decide how we abstract KYC and KYB vendors so a bad provider day doesn't turn into an outage.

 - Design fail-closed behavior and audit trails that hold up under regulatory scrutiny.

 - Identify the classes of failure that keep recurring and remove them for good.

 - Write and drive architecture decisions (ADRs), and hold the line on security and compliance at design time, not as a late gate.

 - Mentor and raise the bar for senior engineers through design reviews, code, and direct feedback.

 - Be measured on whether verification gets faster, more of it decides itself, fewer decisions are wrong, and the systems stay up — and on whether the team got stronger for you being on it.

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Around eight years building and running production systems, with a track record of owning a domain's technical direction, not just delivering inside one.

 - Deep, fluent expertise in Rust, with the versatility to work across TypeScript and React where verification meets the customer.

 - You've set architecture other people build on, and it held up — you can point to specific classes of failure you designed out, not just incidents you fixed.

 - You've made teams faster through patterns, tooling, or mentoring — engineers around you got better and shipped more because of calls you made.

 - You've built where being wrong had real consequences: compliance, payments, security, or anywhere a bad call costs more than a rough user experience.

 - Strong on distributed systems, service contracts, and secure design — you've integrated third-party APIs that couldn't be trusted, with real timeouts, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, and backup paths that actually get tested.

Job Description
As the Head of Internal Audit, you will lead the Group’s independent Internal Audit function, providing objective assurance and strategic insight on the effectiveness of Swissquote’s governance, risk management and internal control framework.
Reporting directly to the Board of Directors and its Audit & Risk Committee, the role oversees the Internal Audit function across the Swissquote Group, defining a risk-based audit strategy and ensuring appropriate coverage of financial, regulatory, operational, technology and emerging risks.
As the Bank transitions from Category 4 to Category 3 under FINMA's banking categorization, Swissquote will internalize the Internal Audit function currently performed by an external provider. The objective is to broaden the risk assessment expertise, audit planning and internal audit governance in-house, while retaining the flexibility and specialist expertise of external providers through a co-sourced internal audit model.
The Head of Internal Audit will lead the internalization process and build the function from the ground up, including its governance, charter, methodology, team, tools and audit universe. The role will ensure a smooth transition from the outgoing external partner and full compliance with FINMA requirements applicable to a Category 3 institution.
Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, the Head of Internal Audit will maintain the highest standards of independence, professional scepticism and integrity while contributing to the continuous strengthening of Swissquote’s governance and control environment.
This position is a highly visible, build-and-lead mandate, with direct exposure to the Board of Directors and Audit Committee.
Key Responsibilities:
Internal Audit Strategy & Governance
• Define and maintain the Internal Audit strategy, methodology and multi-year audit plan, aligned with Swissquote's business model, risk profile and regulatory requirements.
• Establish, maintain and periodically review the Internal Audit Charter and ensure Board approval and alignment with regulatory and professional standards.
• Develop a risk-based audit universe and annual audit plan, ensuring appropriate coverage of material financial, operational, technological and regulatory risks.
• Ensure that Internal Audit operates in accordance with applicable FINMA requirements and recognised professional standards.
• Regularly assess the effectiveness and adequacy of the Internal Audit framework and continuously improve its methodology, tools and processes.
• Maintain an appropriate level of independence from the activities and functions being audited.
• Establish safeguards ensuring objectivity and independence of the Internal Audit function and address any actual, potential or perceived impairments.
• Lead and personally perform selected audits in areas where the Head of Internal Audit’s expertise is most relevant or where the use of external resources is not justified by risk, complexity, or cost.
• Maintain overall accountability for the quality, supervision and reliance placed on work performed by co-sourcing partners and external specialists.
• Across the years, progressively build and develop the Internal Audit team in line with the evolution of the function and the organisation’s risk profile, with strong emphasis on internal development, cross-functional exposure and the development of future audit talent. Establish a clear vision for a lean and digitally enabled Internal Audit function, including the development of data analytics, IT audit capabilities, automated monitoring and management dashboards.
• Design, implement and maintain a Quality Assurance and Improvement Program (QAIP) covering internal and external assessments, performance measurement and continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function and ensure the QAIP is assessed in accordance with Global Internal Audit Standards.
• Develop and manage the Internal Audit budget and resource plan, ensuring sufficient capabilities and capacity to fulfil the approved audit plan.
• Establish and report performance metrics demonstrating the effectiveness, efficiency and value contribution of Internal Audit.
Risk & Control Assurance
• Provide independent assurance to the Board and Executive Management on the effectiveness of Swissquote's governance, risk management and internal control framework, through a risk-based and forward-looking audit approach.
• Lead the assessment of risks across the organisation and ensure that the Internal Audit plan evolves in line with Swissquote's risk profile and business strategy.
• Challenge management constructively on significant control weaknesses, risk exposures and remediation plans, ensuring that material findings are appropriately addressed and escalated when necessary.
Board and Audit & Risk Committee
• Act as the primary Internal Audit advisor to the Board of Directors and its Audit & Risk Committee, providing an independent view on the overall effectiveness of Swissquote's governance, risk management and control environment.
• Present and discuss the Internal Audit Charter, the Internal Audit strategy, annual plan, key findings, emerging risk themes and QIAP.
Regulatory & External Stakeholder Management
• Maintain a constructive relationship with FINMA, the external audit firm and other relevant regulatory stakeholders.
• Coordinate, where appropriate, with external audit and other assurance functions (internal and external) to ensure appropriate coverage and avoid unnecessary duplication.
• Ensure that Internal Audit is prepared to respond effectively to regulatory reviews and supervisory expectations.
• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their implications for the Internal Audit plan.
Digital & Technology Audit
• Ensure adequate audit coverage of IT architecture, applications, infrastructure and technology governance.
• Assess cybersecurity, identity and access management, data management and technology resilience.
• Review the governance and control environment surrounding AI and emerging technologies.
• AI fluency, with demonstrated experience, a strong sensitivity to AI-related topics, and the ability to confidently assess and challenge AI-generated outputs.
• Develop appropriate use of data analytics and automation within Internal Audit.
• Ensure Internal Audit evolves alongside Swissquote's technology and digital transformation.
People Leadership
• Build, lead, develop and motivate the Internal Audit team and foster a strong culture of professional scepticism, independence, integrity and continuous improvement.
• Attract, develop, and retain top talents while ensuring clear roles, performance goals, and career progression paths.
• Ensure appropriate professional development and certification of Internal Audit professionals.

Qualifications
Education & Professional Qualifications
• Master's degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Law or another relevant discipline from a recognised university.
• Professional Internal Audit qualification, Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) or Federal Diploma as a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) is a must.
• In-depth knowledge of the Swiss banking regulatory environment and FINMA requirements, particularly in relation to corporate governance, risk management, internal controls and Internal Audit.
• Ability to assess the effectiveness, scope, documentation, and lessons learned from the previously outsourced internal audit model.
• Build strong working relationships with senior management while reinforcing the independent role of internal audit.
• Strong understanding of international banking regulation and recognised industry practices.
• Excellent analytical, communication, report-writing, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
• High level of integrity, independence, professional judgment, and discretion.
• Strong business acumen with the ability to identify emerging strategic, operational, financial, and compliance risks.
• English is a must, French and German an asset.
Professional Experience
• 10+ years of relevant experience in internal/external audit, risk management and assessment, compliance or a closely related function within financial services.
• At least 3 years as a Head Internal Audit, Internal Audit Director, or Big 4 Senior Manager/Director, preferably with direct exposure to the Board of Directors and/or Audit Committee, ideally with an experience managing co-sourced or outsourced audit providers.
• Demonstrated experience within a FINMA-regulated Swiss bank or comparable internationally regulated banking environment.
• Strong knowledge of Global Internal Audit Standards (IIA Standards 2024) and quality assessment requirements.
• Proven experience in establishing, insourcing or significantly transforming an Internal Audit function within a regulated financial institution is strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to develop an Internal Audit function from the ground up, including the Internal Audit Charter, audit universe, risk assessment methodology, audit strategy, risk-based audit plan, audit methodology, reporting framework, issue follow-up process, quality assurance programme, technology/tooling and staffing model.
• Experience managing the transition from an outsourced Internal Audit model to an effective in-house function, including knowledge transfer, documentation handover, recruitment and selective use of co-sourcing arrangements.
• Strong knowledge of key banking risks, including credit, market, liquidity, operational, compliance, AML/financial crime, conduct, cross-border, technology/cybersecurity and outsourcing risks.
• Proven ability to interact effectively with FINMA, external auditors, the Board/Audit Committee and senior management.
• Significant international exposure and experience working across multiple jurisdictions.

Additional Information
Please note that Swissquote never requests sensitive personal information or payment of any kind during the recruitment process. Any such request is fraudulent.

London

We’re hiring an ML Ops Engineer to build and operate the platform capabilities that take machine-learning models from experimentation into reliable production services.

You’ll own the automation, deployment, observability and operational controls around the ML lifecycle, working closely with research engineers, software engineers, platform teams and product teams.

This is not a research role. It is a hands-on engineering role focused on making ML systems reproducible, scalable, secure and dependable, from model packaging and release through to serving, monitoring, retraining and incident response.

What you’ll work on
ML lifecycle and platform engineering
• Build repeatable workflows for model training, validation, promotion, deployment and retraining.
• Productionise models through packaging, versioning, model registry integration, deployment automation and safe rollback.
• Design CI/CD pipelines for ML systems, including automated testing, validation, release controls and environment promotion.
• Manage experiment tracking, model metadata and reproducibility across research and production.
• Build reusable tooling and platform capabilities that support multiple models and engineering teams.
Model serving and observability
• Deploy and operate batch and online inference services in containerised cloud environments.
• Define and meet availability, latency, throughput and recovery objectives for ML services.
• Monitor service health, infrastructure, data-quality signals, data drift, prediction drift and model performance decay.
• Establish dashboards, alerting and operational runbooks so failures are detected and resolved quickly.
• Support automated or controlled retraining, model promotion, rollback and model retirement.
• Debug production issues across model, application, infrastructure and critical data-dependency layers.
Reliability, security and engineering quality
• Improve system robustness, scalability and cost efficiency through automation, observability and infrastructure as code.
• Write production-grade Python for long-running services, deployment tooling and ML workflows.
• Establish testing, validation, release and incident-management practices for ML systems.
• Collaborate with platform, security and data engineering teams on reliable model inputs, access controls, secrets, resilience and compliance.
• Make explicit trade-offs between research flexibility, delivery speed, operational risk and production stability.
Additional responsibilities
• Maintain personal/professional development to meet the changing demands of the role, including all relevant regulatory and legislative training
• When dealing with all customers, clients or colleagues ensure that we provide a clear, fair and consistent high quality service that presents a professional and positive image of CMC Markets
• Take all reasonable steps to ensure appropriate confidentiality
• Undertake such other duties, training and/or hours of work as may be reasonably required and which are consistent with the general level of responsibility of this role

KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• 3–7 years’ professional experience in MLOps, ML platform engineering, ML infrastructure, backend engineering, DevOps or SRE.
• Strong production Python skills, including clean APIs, testing, performance awareness and maintainable services.
• Experience deploying, serving and operating machine-learning models in production environments.
• Practical understanding of the ML lifecycle, including training, validation, inference, model release, monitoring and retraining.
• Experience designing CI/CD workflows and release processes for ML or other production software systems.
• Hands-on experience with at least one workflow or orchestration system used for ML training, validation or deployment.
• Comfort working with cloud infrastructure, containers, infrastructure as code and service networking.
• Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, alerting, incident response and common failure modes in ML systems.
• Ability to reason about system design, reliability and operational trade-offs—not just individual tools.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with research, engineering, platform, security and product teams.
Nice to have
• Prior ownership of model monitoring, drift detection or automated retraining.
• Familiarity with model registries, feature stores and offline/online feature-consistency challenges.
• Experience supporting multiple models, services or teams on a shared ML platform.
• Exposure to regulated or high-reliability production environments.
• Experience with PyTorch or similar ML frameworks and model-serving technologies.

Technology environment
Language: Python
ML tooling: PyTorch or similar frameworks, experiment tracking and model registries
Workflow orchestration: ML workflows for training, validation, deployment and retraining
Deployment: Containers, model-serving frameworks and infrastructure as code
Observability: Metrics, logging, tracing, alerting and monitoring across model, service and platform layers
Cloud: Managed compute, storage and networking, with a provider-agnostic mindset
The technology stack will evolve. We value engineers who understand why systems are designed in particular ways and can adapt as requirements and tools change.

Machine-learning models only create value when they are correct, observable and dependable in production. This role is responsible for making that happen.

If you care about operational clarity, robust engineering and building ML systems that do not silently fail, this role gives you direct leverage over the success of our machine-learning capabilities.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the role

OKX runs a large peer-to-peer (P2P) crypto marketplace: an escrow-protected orderbook where users buy and sell crypto for local fiat through verified liquidity providers, with support for a wide range of local payment methods. The professional liquidity providers who post offers are what keep the marketplace deep and reliable.

You will own the relationship with these key liquidity providers in various markets: supporting partners' operational needs, maintaining marketplace depth and reliability, and improving partner experience. This is a builder's seat: high ownership, frontline, and fast-moving.

What you'll do

•

Own the P2P liquidity provider programme: monitor marketplace depth and coverage, and improve partner satisfaction and retention

•

Manage the liquidity-provider programme, tiering frameworks, account management and retention strategies.

•

Lead the growth strategy and retention funnel with data: build and read funnels, produce recurring analysis, and turn it into decisions.

•

Contribute to user quality and marketplace health, partnering with the user risk team on high-risk user profiling and dispute reduction. (Growth is the priority; risk exposure is a plus, not a requirement.)

What we're looking for

•

7+ years in growth, account management or relationship management for high-value users or clients, including team leadership, with a track record of managing partner programmes at scale. Multi-market experience is strongly preferred.

•

Proven experience managing high-volume client or partner relationships and improving partner engagement and service quality.

•

Strong data and funnel fluency: owns metrics, runs analysis, steers decisions from data.

•

High-energy and genuinely hungry: gets on the frontline, has built something 0 to 1, and pushes into harder markets rather than safer ones.

•

Backgrounds in payments, remittance or fintech are especially relevant. Crypto or digital-currency experience is a plus, not a requirement. Strong operators from large internet and marketplace companies are also welcome.

•

Working proficiency in English. At least one of the two roles also requires working proficiency in Mandarin (liquidity-provider and stakeholder coverage across Greater China markets).

Nice to have

•

Experience with fiat on-ramp / off-ramp, cross-border payments, or remittance.

•

Exposure to emerging markets (Southeast Asia, Africa, LatAm, MENA).

•

Experience with user-segmentation, high-risk-user filtering, or trust and safety / fraud operations.

About the Opportunity

About the Liquidity Platform

The Liquidity Platform provides technology covering the full lifecycle of cryptocurrency trading, including venue connectivity, real-time market data processing, automated quoting and trading, order execution, position management, risk controls, and data analytics. The platform connects to centralized exchanges, decentralized venues, and event contract markets worldwide. It supports spot, derivatives, and event contract products and provides stable, efficient infrastructure for our liquidity business.

About the Options Market Making Team

The Options Market Making team develops and operates automated options quoting and trading systems. Our responsibilities span market data integration, options pricing, volatility and Greeks calculations, automated quoting, order execution, position management, hedging, and risk controls. The team owns the complete trading lifecycle and continues to advance both the multilingual development of our trading systems and our AI-native engineering practices. In this role, you will contribute across the trading system, develop an understanding of its different business domains, and take end-to-end responsibility from requirements analysis and implementation through production operation.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Design, develop, and operate automated options market making systems covering market data, pricing, quoting, order execution, hedging, positions, and risk controls.

• Work closely with trading, quantitative, and product teams to translate business requirements into reliable, testable production systems.

• Contribute to the development of trading systems and continuously improve the performance, stability, and maintainability of critical trading paths.

• Follow an AI-native engineering approach by applying AI coding tools to requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, and code review, while remaining accountable for the quality of the final delivery.

• Improve testing, monitoring, alerting, and recovery capabilities, and participate in incident resolution and post-incident reviews.

• Own the technical design and code review of core modules. Senior and Staff engineers will also lead cross-module projects and architectural evolution.

What We Look For In You

• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related discipline.

• At least two years of experience in backend engineering, real-time systems, infrastructure, or trading systems.

• Proficiency in at least one of Java, Rust, or C++, with the ability to work effectively in a multilingual codebase.

• Strong computer science fundamentals, including operating systems, network communication, multithreading, concurrent programming, and distributed systems.

• Proficiency in using AI coding tools for requirements analysis, development, testing, and code review, with the ability to independently evaluate and validate AI-generated designs and code.

• Strong analytical skills, business understanding, ownership, and communication skills, including the ability to read technical materials and communicate in written English.

Technical Requirements

• Proficiency in developing production systems with Java 17+, Rust, or C++, with the ability to design, implement, and troubleshoot within a multilingual codebase.

• Familiarity with Linux development and runtime environments, including the use of common tools for resource analysis, performance diagnostics, and troubleshooting.

• Experience with multithreading, asynchronous processing, network I/O, and high-performance data structures, with an understanding of lock contention, memory allocation, caching, garbage collection, and their impact on latency.

• Ability to use AI coding tools to support requirements analysis, development, testing, and code review, while independently validating the correctness and production safety of generated code.

• Familiarity with TCP, UDP, WebSocket, HTTP, or proprietary exchange protocols, with experience developing real-time data or trading interfaces.

• Ability to design and optimize high-throughput, low-latency systems and identify bottlenecks through profiling, benchmarking, and production metrics.

• Familiarity with real-time messaging and inter-process communication. Experience with Aeron, shared memory, lock-free queues, or binary protocols is preferred.

• Experience building logging, metrics, alerting, and automated recovery capabilities for continuously operating production systems.

• Familiarity with build and dependency management for large multi-module projects, together with experience in unit testing, integration testing, and continuous integration.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in options market making, quantitative trading, exchange connectivity, market data, order management, quoting, hedging, or risk systems.

• Understanding of order books, order lifecycles, and market microstructure.

• Understanding of options pricing, volatility, Greeks, PnL, inventory risk, and dynamic hedging.

• Experience developing low-latency trading systems, real-time market data systems, or high-performance network services.

• Experience evolving multilingual systems or separating performance-sensitive components.

• Experience with market data replay, strategy simulation, trade reconciliation, or production incident resolution.

• Experience using Python for data analysis, backtesting, or production diagnostics.

• Practical experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex in production projects.
